messages:
eva: dropped a short interactive prototype for the routing rules workbench: /staging/rules/workbench-v1. Can we do a quick pass on ordering UX, validation copy, and the preview trace?
omar: looked quickly. love the grouping chips (scopes) but users don't notice the group header as an ordering signal. maybe add a small badge 'evaluated first' on the group with a numeric range (1-3).
nina: keyboard/a11y: there's no way to lock a rule in place. If a row is locked, keyboard reorder should skip it and announce that it's locked. add `aria-disabled` + a tooltip: 'Rule locked by policy'.
rafa: validation copy: current message "Condition error" is too vague for support. Recommend: 'Invalid expression: unknown attribute `user.account_type` in clause 2. Click "Insert placeholder" to add sample value.' include link to conditions docs.
eva: tiny variant of the rule that caused trouble:
```
priority: 5
match: { "contains": "invoice", "header.X-Client": "abc" }
route: "small-cpu-fallback"
```
The preview marked it matched but the trace didn't show which clause matched first.
omar: preview improvement: show an inline evaluated-value table per clause (value seen vs expected) and a tiny breadcrumb of the rule evaluation order. Plus a confidence indicator if multiple rules matched and tie-break used.
nina: colorblind mode note: we rely on green/orange for status chips. Add patterned outlines or icons so status is discernible without color. Also focus ring is 1px for some controls  needs to be 3px for WCAG visible focus.
eva: UX copy tweak: change 'Fallback to compatible variant' -> 'Fallback to secondary model (reduced capacity)' per PM ask. Also rename 'Priority' column header to 'Priority (higher runs first)'.
rafa: new feature ask: 'Simulate with historical traffic' where you can sample N requests from logs and replay. show aggregated route counts and a small histogram of latency estimates. Clicking a bar drills into per-request traces.
omar: ordering affordance: add a 'move to top' button on each row (three dots menu) so users can quickly prioritize a rule without dragging. keep drag for fine reorder. keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down to move to top/bottom.
nina: validation banner idea: persistent header banner showing counts (errors/warnings/infos) + 'Autofix safe items' button. clicking an item jumps to the rule and opens an inline quick-fix menu.
eva: action items: @omar add numeric group badges + move-to-top, @nina draft a11y spec (lock semantics, focus ring, colorblind patterns), @rafa prototype historical traffic sampler and aggregate UI, i'll update copy and the evaluated-value trace.
ux-bot: Accessibility scan: 4 issues found: 1) focus ring below recommended size on rule rows, 2) status chips rely on color only, 3) locked rules not announced, 4) drag handles not keyboard reachable.
eva: thanks all 680 i'll push updated frames later today and record a 30s walkthrough. ping me if you want to pair on the historical-sim wireframe.
